profile.t: Name: Omkar Yelsange. Primary focus: Data Analytics, Data Engineering and Data Science. Based in Pune / Lonavala, Maharashtra, India; open to relocation across India. Multidisciplinary engineering background (Robotics & Automation, full stack, IoT) is described on the Other Work page.

Current role: Data Analyst at Autoline Industries Ltd, June 2026 to present, working with live sensor data collected from physical industrial grinding machines. He received the offer after a GET interview in June 2025.

Education: B.E. Robotics & Automation Engineering, D Y Patil College of Engineering, Akurdi, Pune, 2022-2026, CGPA 8.90/10. HSC (12th): D P Mehta Jr College, Lonavala, 2021-2022, 64.33%. SSC (10th): Adv Bapusaheb Bhonde High School, Lonavala, 2019-2020, 80%.

Certifications (latest first): Deloitte Data Analytics Job Simulation (March 2026); paper presentation certificate for 'Sensor-based Monitoring of Grinding Wheel Efficiency in Surface Grinding Operation' (May 2025); DIPEX State Level Competition Finalist (April 2025); First Consolation Prize at Utkarsh 2K25 (March 2025); Python 101 for Data Science, IBM Cognitive Class (Jan 2025); Prompt Engineering for Everyone, IBM Cognitive Class (Nov 2024).

Co-curricular: active team member of the SARA club (2024-2025); Tech Fest participant; runner-up at Utkarsh 2K25; DIPEX state-level finalist; active team lead and member of the final-year project; research paper published.

Contact: email omkaryelsange1010@gmail.com; GitHub https://github.com/OmkarYelsange; LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/omkar-yelsange; portfolio https://omkary.vercel.app. Phone, salary expectation, notice period and joining date are not published: ask Omkar by email.
Target roles: Data Analyst, Data Engineer / Junior Data Engineer, Data Scientist / Junior Data Scientist, BI Analyst, Business / Data Analytics and junior ML / AI roles.

Data experience: Data Analyst at Autoline Industries Ltd (June 2026 to present); Project Management Internship at Lumax Cornaglia Auto Technologies Pvt Ltd (Jan 2026 to Feb 2026). Detailed responsibilities of the internship are not published.

Data skills - Analytics & BI: Power BI, Excel, Tableau, DAX, EDA, data cleaning, visualization, KPI analysis. Data engineering & cloud: Databricks, PySpark, Delta Lake, AWS S3, Glue, DataBrew, Athena, QuickSight, ETL/ELT, Medallion architecture, data warehousing. Programming & databases: Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, Jupyter, MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB. Data science: statistics, machine learning, NLP, generative AI, Gemini API. Tools: Git, GitHub, VS Code, Postman, Vercel.

DATA ENGINEERING projects: GoodCabs Analytics Platform (repo Databricks-Projects): Databricks pipeline Raw -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold with PySpark and SQL on city and trip data from AWS S3. Databricks Lakehouse Projects (repo Databricks): Apache Spark, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and the Medallion architecture.

DATA ANALYTICS projects: AWS Healthcare Data Pipeline (repo AWS-DA): patient CSVs -> S3 -> Glue DataBrew -> Glue Crawler/Catalog -> Glue ETL -> Athena -> QuickSight. Machine Monitoring Analytics M2 & M35: SQL analysis and KPI dashboards in Power BI and Excel. Airbnb NYC EDA: 20,770 listings, 22 attributes, Python (Manhattan priciest; beds vs price about 0.42; reviews vs reviews per month about 0.63). OLA Ride Analytics: 100,000 bookings, SQL scripts, Power BI dashboard, report and presentation. Zepto Inventory Analysis: SQL + Power BI. Blinkit Grocery Analytics: SQL, Excel, Power BI KPIs. Data Analyst Practice Lab: Excel Bike Sales dashboard, MySQL, Power BI, Python, Tableau Airbnb dashboard.
Other Work page: Full Stack, web, robotics, IoT and hardware projects are on the Other Work page of the portfolio (route /other-work).

Other work experience: Full Stack Development Internship at Drushya Digital India Pvt Ltd, Sept 2025 to Nov 2025 (detailed responsibilities not published). Earlier robotics/IoT work through the B.E. Robotics & Automation degree and the final-year project.

Other skills - Full stack & web: React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, Flask, Django, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, MongoDB, Postman, Netlify, Render, Clerk. Robotics, IoT & embedded: C++, Arduino, ESP32, Blynk, sensors, load cells.

SOFTWARE / WEB projects: SAMS Dashboard (React + Vite, Node.js/Express, MongoDB; real-time monitoring of grinding-machine sensor data). AI ChatBot (React + Vite + Tailwind, Flask, Gemini Flash 2.0). DeepSeek Clone (Next.js, Clerk, MongoDB). YouTube Video & Audio Downloader (Flask, Flask-Login, SQLite, yt-dlp, ffmpeg). Real-Time Chat App (React, Firebase, Zustand). React E-Commerce Store (React, Vite, Redux Toolkit, Clerk). AirBnB Clone (Node.js, Express, EJS). Voting System (Django). IoT Device Platform (React, Express, MongoDB, Socket.io, Recharts). Tools & Jobs is a private repository (details not published).

HARDWARE projects: SAMS Smart Abrasive Monitoring System (final-year project): sensor-based monitoring of grinding wheel efficiency in surface grinding using live data from physical grinding machines; Omkar was team lead and member. IoT Smart Chair Kit: attachable kit tracking posture, sitting time and weight distribution with flex/force sensors and load cells on ESP32 + Arduino Uno and a Blynk dashboard; team of four, Omkar handled IoT integration and documentation. Recognition: First Consolation Prize / runner-up at Utkarsh 2K25, DIPEX 2025 state-level finalist, showcased at Roborastra.
Data portfolio pointer: Omkar's primary focus is data analytics, data engineering and data science, covered on the main portfolio page (route /).
